featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Boat show
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul a boat to Yakima! 👀  

> The yearly Yakima Sprint Boat racing now has a new edition with a regular boat show that is being held at the end of November. For this we require several boats to being hauled to various companies in Yakima from their storage location in Wenatchee.

The event takes place on the **14th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P4sECCF_QEadR)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38596.1792995339.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul a boat  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Yakima.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/516fd848-53ae-41ba-9b78-7974591827c0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Wenatchee** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121346-official-ats-convoy-boat-show/)**!

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.

Para disfrutar de un convoy seguro y organizado, todos los participantes deberán cumplir estas reglas:

1. 🚦 Respetar las normas de TruckersMP en todo momento.

2. 🚛 Mantener una distancia segura con el camión de delante y evitar choques.

3. 🚫 No adelantar dentro del convoy, salvo que el Staff lo indique o sea necesario por seguridad.

4. 🛣️Respetar señales, semáforos y límites de velocidad cuando correspondan.

5. ❌ No realizar adelantamientos peligrosos, bloqueos, trolling o conducción temeraria.

6. 📻 Seguir las indicaciones del Convoy Control y Staff durante toda la ruta.

7. 🅿️ Utilizar únicamente las zonas de estacionamiento indicadas para reunión y paradas.

8. 🔧 Llegar con el camión preparado, combustible suficiente y configuración adecuada.

9. 🎙️ Mantener un comportamiento respetuoso con los demás participantes y la comunidad.

10. ⚠️ Las normas oficiales de TruckersMP tienen prioridad sobre cualquier regla interna del evento.

today.name: Nexon Logistics November Convoy #86
today.description:
![](https://cdn.nexonlogistics.com/images/events/banner/november.png)
Nexon Logistics proudly invites you to join us for our November Convoy, where the roads of Euro Truck Simulator 2 lead us through the breathtaking landscapes of the Nordic Horizons and Scandinavia DLCs.

Our journey begins in Ålesund, a beautiful coastal city surrounded by towering mountains and deep fjords. As engines roar to life, we set out along the E136, heading inland through some of the most scenic roads the Nordic region has to offer.

The convoy will continue through Dombås, Lillehammer, and Hamar, following the iconic E6 corridor. Along the way, drivers will experience winding mountain roads, dense forests, sparkling lakes, and the peaceful atmosphere that makes Scandinavian trucking so enjoyable.

Leaving Hamar behind, we take Route 25 and later join the E45, venturing deeper into the heart of the Nordic wilderness. Endless forests, open landscapes, and picturesque views await as we make our way across the border towards Sweden.

Our destination is Östersund, a vibrant city nestled among the lakes and forests of northern Scandinavia. Here, our convoy will come to a close, marking the end of another memorable journey shared with friends, drivers, and the trucking community.

✨ From the fjords of Norway to the forests of Sweden — every kilometer brings a new adventure. ✨

Come along, share the road, and let's create another unforgettable chapter in our convoy adventures.

today.rule:
# Destiny Holidays Division — Event Rules

1. 🚛 **Follow Convoy Control** — All participants must follow instructions given by Convoy Control and event staff at all times.

2. 🛣️ **Maintain Safe Distance** — Keep a reasonable distance from the truck ahead and avoid unnecessary overtaking.

3. 🚦 **Follow Traffic Rules** — Respect traffic lights, road signs, speed limits, and right-of-way rules wherever applicable.

4. 🚫 **No Reckless Driving** — No ramming, blocking, brake-checking, racing, or intentional collisions.

5. 📻 **Follow Convoy Formation** — Stay in your assigned position and maintain the convoy order throughout the route.

6. 🔄 **No Unnecessary Overtaking** — Overtaking is only permitted when instructed by Convoy Control or when absolutely necessary.

7. 🎙️ **Keep Communications Clear** — Keep voice communications clear during the convoy and avoid unnecessary radio spam.

8. 🅿️ **Follow Parking Instructions** — Park only in designated areas and follow staff instructions during stops and at the destination.

- Přeprava kvalitního Italského Mramoru do Německa!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/1IElp1w.jpeg)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. The CARGO is restricted for the Marble Slabs and Blocks.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, however we will use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **19:30** - Meet at the parking slots in Livorno, Marmo Spa.
*  **20:00**  - Departure from Livorno, Quarry.
*  **20:25**- Passage trough Italy Alpen Highway.
*  **20:30** - Passage trough Austria // Italy border.
*  **20:35** - Passage around the city of Innsbruck.
*  **21:10** - Arrival to the Stuttgart, SanBuilders.
*  **21:15** - Final group photo and end of the event.


![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/OWLH0YB.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Livorno, Marmo Spa - Stuttgart, SanBuilders.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

## PUBLIC SLOTS - GAS STATION

![](https://i.imgur.com/yaQzDlB.jpeg)

## PRIVATE SLOTS - MARMO SPA

![](https://i.imgur.com/0HyMAcF.jpeg)


## RESERVÉ SLOTS - TUNNEL ENTRANCE

![](https://i.imgur.com/Ub7Ub3y.jpeg)


*If your company has less than 5 members or you are a member of our company, you do not need to reserve a slot.*


## [FOR RESERVATION OF SLOT VISIT OUR DISCORD!](https://discord.gg/gHnKQqYpHu)


[![](https://i.imgur.com/c0lnezn.png)](https://trucksbook.eu/company/176895)

[![](https://i.ibb.co/bJD5hMc/Discord.png)](https://discord.gg/gHnKQqYpHu)

upcoming.rule:
![](https://i.ibb.co/sZ0Qcn4/Event-Rules-1.png)
- The Event Staff are recognized as: `Marking | EF` / `Marking | EM` / `Marking | ES` / `Marking | CC` / `Marking | GMs` / `Marking | Real Ops` or `Similar`.
- Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned  is forbidden.
- Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Cars and Bus are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag
- Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)
- Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Overtaking is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.
- Instructions given by Event Staff must be followed.
- Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
- Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
- Participants are allowed to block the parking lane and the left lane at the start and break for a smooth starting and resume. The lane between them must be kept clear for participants who wish to drive to their VTC, petrol station or to leave the convoy. According to this image: https://imgur.com/oRAwvAy.png
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/ksGdCCXQ/Event-Rules-2.png)
- Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
- Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
- Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
- Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.

1. Follow Convoy Instructions:** All participants must follow instructions from the convoy leader and event staff.
2. No Overtaking:** Overtaking other convoy participants is prohibited. Maintain your position in the convoy.
3. Safe Driving:** Drive responsibly, maintain a safe distance, and avoid reckless driving or collisions.
4. Be On Time and Stay in Formation:** Arrive before departure, park in the designated area, and leave only when instructed.
5. Respect All Players:** Treat everyone respectfully and follow all applicable TruckersMP rules.

**Thank you for joining Mpemba Logistics. Drive with Pride • Deliver with Purpose!**
